# Krishnendu Biswas
> AI systems developer, machine learning researcher, and MBA scholar at IIM Ranchi and IIT Madras.

Krishnendu Biswas builds deterministic data pipelines, multi-agent platform architectures, and applied machine learning models. He operates a 12-profile multi-agent estate with human approval gates and has published peer-reviewed AI research with Springer Nature.

## Core Specializations
- Multi-agent system architecture and domain-isolated profiles (Hermes Agent, Python, Linux systemd)
- Applied natural language processing, transformer fine-tuning (LoRA / PEFT), and tabular ML
- Business intelligence and data modeling (Microsoft Power BI PL-300 certified, DAX, Star Schema)
- Quantitative research in educational dialogue and imbalanced data classification

## Case Studies: Multi-Agent Systems
- Multi-Agent Operations Platform: https://krishnendu.me/work/platform/
  12-profile estate with router hub, Discord/Telegram channel routing, kanban hand-offs, 341 skill files, 31 scheduled jobs.
- Model Routing & Tiered Compute: https://krishnendu.me/work/routing/
  Loopback 9Router gateway with provider fallback and deterministic script-before-LLM execution.
- Memory & Self-Documentation: https://krishnendu.me/work/memory/
  Episodic vector memory, curated persistent memory, append-only Autobiography ledger, and automated daily progress reports.
- Reliability, Security & Disaster Recovery: https://krishnendu.me/work/reliability/
  Encrypted backup capsules, GitHub Releases offsite mirror, hourly health audits, and scripted restore.
- Finance Ledger Agent: https://krishnendu.me/work/finance/
  Deterministic digital receipt ingestion from read-only Gmail into idempotent transactions in self-hosted Firefly III.
- LinkedIn Publishing Studio: https://krishnendu.me/work/linkedin-studio/
  Voice-calibrated drafting workflow with anti-AI humanizer pass and mandatory human publishing gate.

## Machine Learning Projects
- Comment Classification: https://krishnendu.me/projects/comment-classification/
  Multi-label comment classification raising F1-Macro from 0.6221 to 0.8293 on 198K comments via 100-trial Optuna study.
- Smart MCQ Solver: https://krishnendu.me/projects/mcq/
  LoRA fine-tuning on DeBERTa-v3 and RoBERTa, achieving 0.74242 MAP@3 on 500 unseen questions.
- Customer Exit Prediction: https://krishnendu.me/projects/customer-exit/
  Benchmark of 8 classifiers over 90,000 records, achieving 0.6365 validation F1 with tuned Random Forest.
- VC Deal Analytics Dashboard: https://krishnendu.me/projects/vc-dashboard/
  3-page Power BI dashboard with 7 DAX measures and 50,000-row star schema.
